name_zh: 哈马德/卡塔尔外交/天然气：永久中立与小国大外交
name_en: Hamad/Qatar Diplomacy/Gas: Permanent Neutrality & Small State Grand Diplomacy
description_zh: 谢赫·哈马德·本·哈利法·阿勒萨尼 (1952-) 卡塔尔前埃米尔/1995-2013 执政/天然气/北方气田/液化天然气/半岛电视台/多哈回合/调解/达尔富尔/黎巴嫩/阿富汗/塔利班/阿拉伯之春/2013 禅位/塔米姆继位。核心模式：小国大外交永久中立 — 天然气财富/媒体软实力/调解者/多边平衡/美军基地/伊朗关系/土耳其/中国/美国/小国杠杆。体现 M195 永久中立/小国外交 — 以"天然气杠杆+媒体软实力+调解者角色+大国平衡"四位一体，在海湾/中东/大国四重博弈中实现小国战略自主。
description_en: Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani (1952-) former Emir of Qatar/1995-2013 rule/natural gas/North Field/LNG/Al Jazeera/Doha Round/mediation/Darfur/Lebanon/Afghanistan/Taliban/Arab Spring/2013 abdication/Tamim succession. Core model: Small State Grand Diplomacy Permanent Neutrality — natural gas wealth/media soft power/mediator role/multipolar balance/US base/Iran relations/Turkey/China/US/small state leverage. Exemplifies M195 Permanent Neutrality/Small State Diplomacy — quaternity of 'natural gas leverage + media soft power + mediator role + great power balance' achieving small state strategic autonomy amid quadruple Gulf/Middle East/great power games.
reason_zh: 卡塔尔非单纯天然气小国，而是"天然气杠杆+半岛电视台+调解者"三位一体战略国家。北方气田提供财富/杠杆，半岛电视台重塑阿拉伯舆论，调解者角色赋予外交话语权。M195 区隔于 M169 后石油转型(沙特)、M171 资源民族主义(委内瑞拉)、M195 永久中立(土库曼)，核心在于"天然气即战略资本+媒体即舆论武器+调解即外交货币"的卡塔尔小国大外交范式。
reason_en: Qatar not mere gas mini-state but 'natural gas leverage + Al Jazeera + mediator' trinity strategic state. North Field provides wealth/leverage, Al Jazeera reshapes Arab discourse, mediator role grants diplomatic currency. M195 distinct from M169 Post-Oil (Saudi), M171 Resource Nationalist (Venezuela), M195 Permanent Neutrality (Turkmenistan), core: 'natural gas as strategic capital + media as opinion weapon + mediation as diplomatic currency' Qatar small state grand diplomacy paradigm.
